units.source_text: 六条院主人闻知朱雀院身心稍稍复健，就前来访晤。

en.t: When the master of Rokujo-in heard that Suzaku-in had somewhat recovered in body and spirit, he came to visit him.

units.source_text: 朝廷对源氏的封赠，一切都与让位之上皇相同。

en.t: All the court's honors and grants to Genji were the same as those given to a retired emperor who had abdicated.

units.source_text: 但源氏表示谦虚，出门并不正式采用太上天皇的仪仗。

en.t: But Genji showed humility, and when he went out he did not formally use the ceremonial retinue of a retired sovereign.

units.source_text: 世人对他特别尊敬，但他故意装得朴素俭约，

en.t: People showed him extraordinary respect, but he deliberately presented himself in a plain and restrained manner,

units.source_text: 照例乘坐不甚讲究的车子，仪仗队中只限上级官员及亲信者得乘车随行。

en.t: riding as usual in a carriage that was not especially splendid, and allowing only senior officials and trusted attendants in the procession to follow by carriage.

units.source_text: 朱雀院盼待已久，不胜欢迎，便在病中振作精神，出来接见。

en.t: Suzaku-in had been longing for this visit and welcomed him with great joy, so despite his illness he summoned his strength and came out to receive him.

units.source_text: 招待排场并不盛大，只在朱雀院自己的起居室中添设客位，延请源氏入座。

en.t: The reception was not grand; a guest seat was simply added in Suzaku-in's own living chamber, and Genji was invited to sit there.

units.source_text: 源氏一见朱雀院的僧装模样，感慨之极，一时茫然若失。

en.t: As soon as Genji saw Suzaku-in dressed as a monk, he was overcome with emotion and for a moment sat dazed, as if he had lost himself.

units.source_text: 悲从中来，两泪夺眶而出，急切不能自制。

en.t: Grief rose from within him, tears burst from both eyes, and for a while he could not control himself.

units.source_text: 良久方始镇静，对他言道：“自从先帝弃养之后，小弟深感人世无常，立意出家学道。

en.t: Only after a long while did he regain his composure and say to him, "Ever since the late emperor passed away, I have deeply felt the impermanence of this world and resolved to leave it and study the Way.

units.source_text: 只缘意志薄弱，因循未能实践，终于让吾兄占先，今天特来拜见清姿。

en.t: But because my will was weak, I delayed and failed to act, and in the end you, my elder brother, went ahead of me. Today I have come especially to behold your pure form.

units.source_text: 我心优柔寡断，行事每落人后，思之不胜羞愧。

en.t: My heart is indecisive, and in everything I do I fall behind others; when I think of it, I am overcome with shame.

units.source_text: 在弟自身，此事实无所谓，故曾屡次痛下决心。

en.t: For my own part, this matter truly should not be difficult, and so I have made firm resolutions many times.

units.source_text: 然而难于抛舍之事甚多，如之奈何！”言下不胜感慨。

en.t: Yet there are so many things that are hard to cast aside; what am I to do!" His words were filled with deep feeling.

units.source_text: 朱雀院也很伤心，颓丧之余，不能振作，只得低声同他谈论旧事新闻，

en.t: Suzaku-in too was deeply saddened, and in his dejection he could not rouse himself; he could only speak with Genji in a low voice about old events and recent news,

units.source_text: 说道：“愚兄虚度光阴，日复一日，竟得苟全性命。

en.t: saying, "I, your foolish elder brother, have wasted the days, one after another, and somehow managed to keep myself alive.

units.source_text: 常恐放逸成性，致使学道之大愿不能成遂，因此发愤出家。

en.t: I constantly feared that indulgence would become my nature and keep my great wish to study the Way from being fulfilled, and so I roused myself and became a monk.

units.source_text: 如今虽已剃度，但倘余命无多，则修行之愿仍不得偿。

en.t: Now I have taken the tonsure, but if little life remains to me, my wish for religious practice still cannot be satisfied.

units.source_text: 然而暂不入山，在此间亦复清闲，至少可以一心念佛。

en.t: Still, though I have not yet gone into the mountains, life here is quiet enough, and at least I can devote myself single-mindedly to reciting the Buddha's name.

units.source_text: 像我这羸弱之体，居然也能长生至今，全靠这修行之志将性命留住。

en.t: That a frail body like mine has somehow lived this long is entirely because this resolve to practice has kept my life in me.

units.source_text: 我并非不知此理，但因素性懈怠，一向不曾修持，于心有所不安耳。”

en.t: It is not that I do not understand this truth, but because I have always been lazy by nature and have never truly practiced, uneasiness remains in my heart."
